publisher.name: Podium
publisher.editorialControl: Podium selects the products, rubric, sources and wording, including for comparisons that do not include Podium.
publisher.disclosure: Podium publishes this catalog and sells an agent development environment. Podium chooses the products, criteria, sources and wording, so treat these pages as vendor-authored research. Check important claims against the linked primary sources. The same evidence rules apply to Podium and its competitors, but they do not remove this conflict of interest.

unknownMeans: The available public evidence does not establish this value. Unknown is never no.

verification.sourced: A claim passed the publication gates. A filter value also has a typed mapping that matches its evidence digest, without an accepted independent check of both.
verification.agent-cross-checked: On a claim, a different agent checked its evidence, wording, scope and dates. On a filter value, a different agent checked both the public finding and the typed mapping. Lifecycle status copies the verification of its typed notice. This does not imply a hands-on test or human claim review.
verification.unknown: The filter value has no eligible receipt.

freshnessRule: Findings and typed values stay published after nextCheckAt. Show their checked date and age; add a quiet "may be outdated" note only after six calendar months. A rebuild never refreshes evidence.
evidenceText: Evidence contains a finding and a locator. A finding may summarize a source and must not be presented as a verbatim quote.
correctionRule: Provide a public source URL and its exact sentence. Verify the correction in the catalog before regenerating this package.
limitations: Documentation and source inspection do not establish successful hands-on use.
A missing sourced finding is not evidence that a capability is absent.
Clients, plans, versions and execution modes may have different capabilities. Read the receipt scope.
Register listings identify products and contain no capability claims. A sourced first-party lifecycle notice can name a listed product before an independent cross-check.
